original_failure: Type "PWC.EditorApp::EAHierarchyResult" was not found in the IL2CPP metadata.

root_cause.summary: The type does not exist in this build's IL2CPP metadata/binary at all. TypeTreeGenerator.get_nodes_as_json() fails immediately with 'Type "PWC.EditorApp::EAHierarchyResult" was not found in the IL2CPP metadata.' before any field layout can even be attempted - this is not a parsing bug, the type genuinely is not present to parse.
root_cause.evidence: Confirmed 2026-11-22: not one of the 20 PWC.EditorApp.* classes with this exact failure signature exists anywhere in out/cpp2il/DiffableCs (the full Cpp2IL static decompile of this build's Assembly-CSharp) - not even the literal string 'EditorApp' appears anywhere in that decompiled tree. Checked systematically (grep across the whole tree), not by sampling.
root_cause.interpretation: Classic Unity/IL2CPP managed code stripping: PWC.EditorApp.* is internal level/content editor tooling (login, search, hierarchy, level-editor panels - judging by the class names) that is never statically referenced by the shipped game code path, so the IL2CPP build stripped the types entirely. A stale MonoScript object (just a name string pointing at the now-absent type) remains in the serialized assets, which is why out/mb/_stats.json still lists it as a failing class instead of simply absent.

fix: None possible - the type is not in the binary to parse. Not a tools/mb_dump.py bug.
resolvability: Confirmed unresolvable with any static-analysis approach against this build. The only theoretical recourse would be an older/different build of the APK that still ships this editor tooling, which is out of scope.
